name: Orange Pride
description: Fuselage: Forward fuselage from the nose to just ahead of the wing bright orange; aft of that standard KLM: sky-blue crown, white lower fuselage. Cheatlines: A thin dark-blue line under the windows (standard KLM). Tail: White fin with the blue KLM crown logo. Engines: White with blue KLM logo. Winglets: Raked tips. Titles: White 'KLM' crown and 'Royal Dutch Airlines' on the orange section. Artwork: none. Colors hex: approximate.
